SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.unit, p.status, p.category_id, c.category_path, pi.file_path AS image_path, pi.original_name, sum(s.quantity) as quantity FROM product p JOIN stock s ON p.product_id = s.product_id LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON p.image_id = pi.image_id JOIN ( SELECT category_id, LTRIM(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(category_name, '>'), '>') AS category_path FROM category START WITH parent_id IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR category_id = parent_id ) c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
p.product_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.category_path LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
and p.status = #{status}
group by p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.unit, p.status, p.category_id, c.category_path, pi.file_path, pi.original_name order by p.product_id offset #{offset} rows fetch next #{pagesize} rows only
